items.Boundary acceptance case: Multi-tenant status alone does not fail.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Certificate expires within approved lead time (default 30 days) and renewal readiness is absent.
items.Evidence contract: Certificate validity + deployment mapping + renewal job
items.Boundary acceptance case: Automated successful near-term renewal context reduces operational risk.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Same public-key fingerprint spans disallowed trust zones or services.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Infer reuse, not private-key theft; approved shared endpoint is exception.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Algorithm/key size violates versioned customer crypto policy for that use.
items.Boundary acceptance case: SHA-1 signature vs fingerprint hash distinguished; RSA threshold configurable.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Wildcard/SAN scope exceeds authorized endpoint boundary or key distribution policy.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Valid constrained wildcard must not be automatically vulnerable.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Presented workload certificate is absent from inventory or violates approved chain/identity policy.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Approved private CA/self-signed trust anchor passes; untrusted chain fails.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Exposed or policy-expired administrative token; distinguish metadata-only observation from validated capability.
items.Evidence contract: Token scope/expiry where available + repo evidence
items.Boundary acceptance case: Unavailable personal-token inventory reported as gap.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Write-enabled deploy key is used across unauthorized repos or exceeds intended deployment need.
items.Boundary acceptance case: GitHub deploy keys evaluated by actual repo scope, not assumed global access.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Fork/PR-controlled code can reach protected credentials under trigger and permission semantics.
items.Evidence contract: Workflow revision + trust settings + runner context
items.Boundary acceptance case: Safe fork trigger with no secrets passes.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Untrusted actor can alter protected build/deploy workflow or trusted runner execution context.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Repo workflow exists != self-modifying exploit.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Identity has effective bypass and lacks approved necessity/compensating controls.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Missing administration read scope => unknown.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Effective logon policy allows interactive use against defined bot-only requirement.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Identity type/name is insufficient evidence.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Multiple unrelated bots share credential reference/fingerprint without approved boundary.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Shared orchestrator-managed credential evaluated with policy context.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Linked bot principal has effective privileged directory group rights beyond purpose.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Vendor administrator role is not automatically domain admin.

items.Fail condition / applicability: SPN-bearing service account has risky encryption, privilege or lifecycle characteristics; weak password not claimed from passive inventory.
items.Boundary acceptance case: No ticket cracking or password collection in standard offering.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Delegation enabled on relevant computer/service account outside approved configuration.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Account-specific context avoids classifying every expected DC setting as same risk.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Effective membership/ACL permits unauthorized principals to read managed password.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Do not retrieve managed password; directory adapter instead of guessed Certipy function.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Transitive privileged group or ACL rights exceed service requirement.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Resolve nested groups and deny/precedence as supported.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Linked-server login maps to elevated remote rights without approved need.
items.Evidence contract: DB metadata export + remote rights evidence
items.Boundary acceptance case: Remote rights unavailable => possible exposure, not proved sysadmin.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Agent uses non-expiring or overdue credential against policy.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Credential ref without expiry evidence => unknown.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Granted tool/resource capabilities exceed sponsor-approved task contract.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Entra scopes alone cannot represent all tools.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Same delegated execution context can combine sensitive read and unauthorized external write across trust boundary.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Composition with enforced intermediary approval is represented; sandbox-only validation later.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Gateway/runtime observation has no matching current sponsored registry identity.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Partial registry export => unknown, not shadow agent count.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Configured MCP server lacks required auth, approved identity or manifest review.

items.Boundary acceptance case: No-auth public tool distinguished from sensitive tool; auth alone does not prevent poisoning.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Effective sshd configuration permits direct root key login outside emergency policy.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Same public key exceeds approved host/trust-zone boundary (10-host threshold is only a configurable review trigger).
items.Boundary acceptance case: Authorized fleet automation may be exception; scope determines risk.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Authorized public key has no current service owner or retained business purpose.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Unknown owner reported separately from proven retired identity.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Credential policy requires review/rotation and the permitted window is exceeded or record unavailable.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Missing record is unknown compliance; do not assert key age from file mtime.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Approved synthetic event produces expected rule alert within agreed latency.

items.Boundary acceptance case: Rule exists alone is not pass; disabled active test => unknown with reason not_tested.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Applicable creation event source and enabled analytic rule absent or unhealthy.
items.Evidence contract: Rule metadata + ingestion freshness + event schema
items.Boundary acceptance case: Passive configuration check distinct from tested detection effectiveness.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Child capabilities exceed parent scope, target boundary or expiry.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Capability intersection fixture rejects amplification.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Gateway accepts mismatched, expired, reused or missing action-bound approval.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Passive rule/config evidence; adversarial tests run only in platform lab.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Active agent lacks accountable sponsor, purpose or retirement controls.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Missing registry fields fail governance rule without inventing owner.

items.Fail condition / applicability: No configured task, delegation, spend or timeout ceilings for registered agent.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Budget visible but unenforced is separate test finding.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Persistent memory mixes tenants or promotes unsourced tool content to trusted instructions.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Runtime isolation needs lab validation; passive evidence qualifies claim.

items.Boundary acceptance case: Do not capture raw customer tokens.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Observed tool manifest digest differs from approved version.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Authorized version update passes after reviewed re-registration.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Tool events cannot link agent, sponsor, delegation chain and run.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Sampling coverage reported; absent sample is unknown.

items.Fail condition / applicability: OIDC subject/audience trust permits unapproved repos/branches/environments.

items.Boundary acceptance case: Fork and unprotected branch cases covered.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Workflow executes mutable external action/dependency without approved integrity policy.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Pinned reviewed digest passes; approved tag exception tracked.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Eligible active principal lacks verified business and technical owner.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Missing owner remains separate from missing discovery coverage.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Identity retains unnecessary overlapping credentials beyond approved rotation overlap window.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Legitimate short overlap passes; never retrieve credentials.

items.Fail condition / applicability: SAN/URI identity or issuing trust domain does not match approved workload identity.
items.Evidence contract: Cert metadata + service registry + trust bundle
items.Boundary acceptance case: Self-signed alone not deciding factor.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Revocation/retirement events have no monitored ingestion or response ownership.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Presence and exercised response tracked separately.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Last complete source snapshot exceeds approved freshness window.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Fresh partial snapshot does not reset complete-scan freshness.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Authorized scope cannot be fully enumerated due to denied API or pagination failure.
items.Evidence contract: Source scope + permission and page outcomes
items.Boundary acceptance case: Gap not counted as secure entities or zero findings.

items.Fail condition / applicability: Agent can transmit sensitive context to destinations outside approved data boundary.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Read-only upstream access still requires downstream egress control.

items.Fail condition / applicability: No independent revoke/disable capability covering delegated identities and active tool dispatch.
items.Boundary acceptance case: Claim tested only after controlled kill drill.

items.Subject: Three separate axes
items.Normative rule: Keep severity, assurance and remediation priority separate. A high-impact config-supported finding can remain high impact without active proof.
items.Implementation / acceptance: UI and exports show all three; risk acceptance changes workflow, not evidence truth.

items.Subject: Severity inputs
items.Normative rule: Use impact critical/high/moderate/low, exposure untrusted/internal/constrained, effective privilege elevated/limited, path certainty confirmed/possible, credential state exposed/enabled/unknown.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Customer criticality is attested input. Missing essential inputs => undetermined. No LLM severity and no unexplained multiplication.

items.Subject: Severity baseline policy
items.Normative rule: Critical: confirmed effective path from untrusted context to customer-designated critical asset with elevated privilege, or confirmed exposed enabled privileged credential. High: effective elevated unauthorized access with constrained/internal reach, or serious exposure with partial path certainty.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Only deterministic check evidence can set predicates. Exposed candidate with unknown validity does not automatically meet critical rule. Customer policy may override via reviewed version.

items.Subject: Other severity bands
items.Normative rule: Medium: evidenced excessive rights/lifecycle/trust weakness without a confirmed high-impact route. Low: bounded hygiene/governance weakness. Informational: review signal with no established weakness.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Check implementation provides rationale and contextual impact. Unknown inputs yield undetermined instead of guessed low.

items.Subject: Rule order and exceptions
items.Normative rule: Critical rules first, then High, Medium, Low, Informational; exact policy bundle version and input hash saved. Overrides need reviewer, reason, expiry and original severity retained.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Test conflicting predicates, missing inputs, boundaries, policy outage and version change. Policy authoring separate from model output.

items.Subject: Posture score
items.Normative rule: For each dimension use pass count / assessed applicable count. Weights: ownership 20%, credential hygiene 25%, least privilege 25%, lifecycle 15%, detection 15%.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Score Calculator demonstrates this explicitly. Missing dimensions block aggregate; never normalize missing dimensions away.

items.Subject: Completeness
items.Normative rule: Assessed count / eligible count per dimension; unknown/error/not-collected stay outside assessed and visible inside eligible where known. Eligible denominator unknown => completeness unavailable.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Provisional score only for observed scope. Customer-wide score requires every completeness >=90% and known scope denominators; 90% is a proposed policy threshold, not a standard.

items.Subject: Avoid correlated double-counting
items.Normative rule: Each dimension evaluates one Boolean control-set outcome per eligible identity (or approved detection scenario), not one score increment per duplicate finding.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Correlate duplicate credentials/paths and preserve check evidence. Document eligible universe and snapshot for each dimension.

items.Subject: Ownership definition
items.Normative rule: Pass when all required owner fields are attested and current for eligible identities. Discovery coverage is separate.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Estimated total estate produces estimated coverage label, never precise completeness.

items.Subject: Least privilege definition
items.Normative rule: Pass when current approved purpose is satisfied with no evidenced excessive effective privileges under supported semantics. Legitimate crown-jewel access is not automatically a failure.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Unknown permissions/conditions yield unknown result; no path found in incomplete graph is not proof of safety.

items.Subject: Detection denominator
items.Normative rule: Eligible scenarios are agreed, safe, versioned detection cases. Assessed means exercised to completion; pass means expected alert within SLA.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Pilot without exercised detection leaves aggregate unavailable; show available dimension scores and completeness.

items.Subject: FAIR option
items.Normative rule: Quantify only with customer-approved loss event frequency and magnitude ranges, sources, model version and sensitivity. Report percentile ranges and assumptions.
items.Implementation / acceptance: No dollar figure from severity alone. No double-counting shared scenarios. Otherwise deliver qualitative risk register.

items.Subject: Control mapping
items.Normative rule: Map a finding to exact framework edition/control when supported. Store applicability, rationale and evidence coverage; allow partial/unmapped.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Mapping is evidence support, not attestation. Validate PCI/ISO/DORA wording and applicability with responsible reviewer.

items.Subject: ATT&CK mapping
items.Normative rule: Assign only supported adversary behaviors with versioned technique references. A misconfiguration is a prerequisite, not itself an observed technique.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Do not blindly retain original T1553/T1550 assignments or force one technique per check.

items.Subject: Closure and recurrence
items.Normative rule: Resolve only after fresh complete retest proves relevant weakness removed. Accepted risks expire. New observation of resolved condition reopens finding with occurrence history.
items.Implementation / acceptance: Disappearing from partial scan cannot close finding. Preserve prior snapshot.

items.Layout and information: Coverage and freshness first; active missions, confirmed critical exposure, approvals due, connector issues and owner tasks.
items.Primary interaction: Select a mission opens run workspace preserving tenant/scope filters. Start assessment opens scope wizard.
items.Required states / safety: Empty: onboarding checklist. Partial: visible excluded sources. Never show zero risk because no scan exists.

items.Layout and information: Steps: organization and region; SSO; ROE/scope; crown jewels; source connections; permissions test; baseline preview.
items.Primary interaction: Draft autosave; explicit scope diff before launch. Broker connection flow never accepts secrets into chat.
items.Required states / safety: Permission error shows missing API capability and customer admin remediation. Resume at last completed step.

items.Layout and information: Searchable table: mission, scope, mode, state, coverage, started, duration, cost budget, owner.
items.Primary interaction: Saved views and compare two compatible snapshots. Draft/run creation permission explicit.
items.Required states / safety: Queued, blocked, running, waiting approval, partial, failed, cancelled and complete distinct.

items.Layout and information: Left task lanes; center dependency graph or list; right evidence inspector; bottom chronological events. Header shows scope, passive/active mode, budget and kill/pause controls.
items.Primary interaction: Click agent/task focuses its inputs, artifacts, tool receipts and blockers. Follow-live toggle never steals manual focus.
items.Required states / safety: Real node state only. Last update and reconnect banner visible. Paused means dispatch stopped; in-flight work may remain.

items.Layout and information: Pending proposals sorted by expiry/impact. Side-by-side scope, expected effects, evidence, template version, action digest, remaining approvers.
items.Primary interaction: Review -> approve/deny with reason. Two separate human approvals. Changed content clears approvals.
items.Required states / safety: Expired/revoked/stale proposal disables submit. No bulk approval of active actions. Re-auth before sensitive approval.

items.Layout and information: Virtualized table with type, provider, business/technical owner, privilege, credential expiry, lifecycle, findings and freshness.
items.Primary interaction: Saved filters, column chooser, owner assignment; query chips are structured predicates.
items.Required states / safety: Unowned, unresolved identity links and stale sources prominent. Export permission checked server-side.

items.Layout and information: Summary plus tabs: permissions, credentials metadata, ownership, relationships, findings and activity timeline.
items.Primary interaction: Trace permission back to source policy. Owner attestation and scoped retest.
items.Required states / safety: Secret values never shown. Different source assertions remain inspectable.

items.Layout and information: Start from a selected identity/crown jewel; bounded graph, policy edge inspector, time snapshot selector and scope breadcrumbs.
items.Primary interaction: Expand one hop, filter edge type, pin path, compare snapshot, switch to equivalent path table.
items.Required states / safety: Display edge certainty and conditions. Path cap and hidden-node count prevent misleading whole-estate view.

items.Layout and information: Facets for severity, assurance, owner, lifecycle, asset, source and accepted risk. Group duplicates with occurrences.
items.Primary interaction: Bulk assign owner only within permissions. Compare revisions, retest, request exception.
items.Required states / safety: No active proof is a labeled evidence limitation, not a suppressed finding.

items.Layout and information: Title and impact, observed facts, evaluated policy, config/test assurance, path, redacted evidence and remediation plan.
items.Primary interaction: Every claim links to exact artifact/observation. AI explanation label opens sources, model/version and limitations.
items.Required states / safety: Evidence expired/unavailable gives reason and escalation; avoid ungrounded confidence percentages.

items.Layout and information: Owner queue, due date, dependency, change ticket, runbook, acceptance criteria and retest result.
items.Primary interaction: Draft ticket -> reviewed export/create; resolve only through retest. Customer remediation execution outside default product.
items.Required states / safety: Blocked change, accepted risk expiry and recurrence clearly distinct.

items.Layout and information: Registry and observed agents; sponsor, purpose, capability/delegation graph, credentials refs, expiry, approved model/tools.
items.Primary interaction: View effective grants vs declared mission; suspend or retire with authorized flow.
items.Required states / safety: Shadow agent is an observed identity absent from complete registry, not merely an unknown name.

items.Layout and information: Permission coverage, last complete sync, partial/error count, version, quota and credential lease state.
items.Primary interaction: Run read-only preflight, rotate connection authorization, inspect errors, disable and reconnect.
items.Required states / safety: No success from HTTP 200 alone; paging and normalization outcomes required.

items.Layout and information: Released reports separate from drafts; snapshot/as-of, coverage, limitations, reviewers and signature.
items.Primary interaction: Preview, evidence navigation, request review, release, authorized download.
items.Required states / safety: Unmapped controls visible. PDF/JSON/CSV exports reconcile to same finding revisions.

items.Layout and information: Filter by actor, run, action and time; integrity verification; timeline scrubber and immutable artifacts.

items.Layout and information: Members/roles, data region, retention, budgets, policy bundle versions, support access and integration destinations.
items.Primary interaction: Sensitive settings show before/after diff with explicit roles, reason and audit record.
items.Required states / safety: Retention/legal-hold conflicts shown; approval role cannot bypass backend policy.

items.Backend contract: POST /v1/runs with scope_version, mode, idempotency key.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Stale scope 409 requires re-preview; no hidden scope expansion.

items.Backend contract: SSE task.state_changed and artifact.created; stable node IDs.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: No fabricated agent dialogue, progress percentages or moving particles when no event occurred.

items.User-visible behavior: Execution graph shows work dependencies; identity graph shows permissions/relationships. Different headings, legends and route contexts.
items.Backend contract: GET run topology vs GET graph paths.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Never imply a task edge represents exploitable access.

items.User-visible behavior: Show completed/total known tasks, unknown remaining count if plan dynamic, per-source collected pages and explicit wait reason.
items.Backend contract: Server-computed counts from task manifest.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: No ETA unless based on measured comparable runs and labeled estimate.

items.User-visible behavior: Resizable 400px drawer: source, collection time, redaction, hash/signature status, claim linkage and permitted preview.
items.Backend contract: GET evidence metadata then short-lived scoped download.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Escape content; no script, HTML or credential rendering.

items.User-visible behavior: Show concise decision summary, inputs, selected action, policy result and artifacts.
items.Backend contract: Persist structured decision summary, model version and prompt version.
items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Do not expose private chain-of-thought; summary is not evidence of correctness.

items.User-visible behavior: Pause stops new dispatch; outstanding task list remains. Resume rechecks scope, credentials, budgets and approvals.

items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Pause is distinct from emergency kill; server receipt drives button state.

items.User-visible behavior: One clear emergency action with immediate request and receipt; show dispatch disabled and in-flight reconciliation status.

items.User-visible behavior: Show exact target/action count, template, changes/effects, duration, expiry, context and two signers.
items.Backend contract: GET proposal immutable revision.

items.User-visible behavior: Ctrl/Cmd+K searches permitted pages, identities and read-only actions. Destructive/active actions open standard review flow.

items.Failure / acceptance requirement: Search results must not leak other tenant names or counts.

items.User-visible behavior: Contextual ask/explain/search; structured plan preview; citations and AI label; suggested filters applied only after review.

items.Backend contract: GET snapshots diff with compatibility metadata.

items.User-visible behavior: Assignee/status changes show pending state; conflicts open revision diff.

items.User-visible behavior: Report/export task provides durable job ID, progress, cancel if possible and result expiry.

items.User-visible behavior: EventSource through same-origin authenticated BFF; sequence cursor, backoff, full snapshot resync if cursor expired.

items.User-visible behavior: Group meaningful alerts by run; approvals/credential failures actionable; configurable channel and quiet hours.

items.User-visible behavior: Preview selected IDs/count/scope for owner assignment and export. Per-item result summary for partial failure.

items.User-visible behavior: Wide: sidebar + canvas + inspector. Tablet: collapsible sidebar/drawer. Small: task list and stacked finding view.

items.Required behavior: Default full baseline then daily delta where supported and weekly full reconciliation; per-source freshness policy configurable.

items.Required behavior: 3 attempts max per task; exponential jitter and Retry-After; 15-minute task deadline default except approved bulk collection.
items.Acceptance / escalation: Read retries bounded; side effects use ledger and reconcile uncertain outcome.

items.Required behavior: Default 4 concurrent connector tasks per run and 10 per tenant; model delegation depth 2 and 40 model calls/run.
items.Acceptance / escalation: Reserve budget atomically; customer-specific limits override only through approved config.

items.Required behavior: Default 100k input+output tokens/run and 120s call deadline as planning guardrails; tenant monetary cap required before enabling paid runtime.
items.Acceptance / escalation: Enforce model-specific tokenizer/pricing supplied in config; stop at reserved cap, never claim fixed runtime cost.

items.Required behavior: Outbox insertion, finding revision and state transition share DB transaction. Consumers deduplicate event IDs.
items.Acceptance / escalation: At-least-once transport; exactly-once external effects not promised.

items.Required behavior: GA target 99.9% monthly control-plane availability; collection freshness per connector; partial source incidents disclosed.
items.Acceptance / escalation: Pilot measures baseline; no SLA until monitored operational proof and agreed exclusions.

items.Required behavior: Encrypted point-in-time DB backup, versioned evidence and signed manifests; graph rebuildable.
items.Acceptance / escalation: Quarterly isolated restore drill with RPO/RTO records and key-access validation.
